gate_items.check: Real OMP temporary canary: Manager slash present+expands+passes user args, model discovery absent, Worker absent; plain user text/notice/peer inputs do not auto-expand. Store version, sanitized requests, output markers, cleanup; 0 paid model calls.

Helper public CLI with temporary canonical reference: complete Korean Markdown/unknown values retained; missing/empty/duplicate headings and oversize drafts rejected without silent clipping; source-independent saved artifact and omission marker cases.
Synthetic API key, bearer, password, credential URL, private key and path/error canaries are absent from saved file, stdout, stderr and fallback; markers remain; no raw temporary body file.

Public CLI default/explicit/space-containing paths, concurrent filename collision, existing file/symlink, permission/disk/partial-write failures: no overwrite, truthful status and same sanitized complete fallback; 0600 output; only owned partial result cleaned.

Shipped skill and reference express the SPEC contract including template read, scope, questions, evidence, unknowns, secrets, missing data, limits, helper/fallback and no reproduction/delegation/repair; this is asset contract evidence only, not observed model compliance.

Product launcher/observe_isolation/role_skill_allowlist with real shipped assets allow report command for Manager only and reject ambient leaks; Worker roster/tools/agents unchanged; actual helper path resolves from skill; existing focused regressions pass.

Independent actual host-agent execution of frozen skill/reference on synthetic normal, partial, unknown-cause, unrelated-project and save-failure cases: questions, inline cited evidence, uncertainty, sanitized full fallback and no forbidden actions observed. Scripted provider replies or text assertions do not satisfy this gate.

Final exact candidate through real OMP Manager slash expansion and actual owned WB bridge+helper with localhost scripted provider: shipped template is read, synthetic status/raw/missing ranges reach report, default/explicit/collision/failure outputs and Worker exclusion verified, artifact moved and read without original sources. This gate proves runtime wiring, with reasoning/interaction quality supplied separately by G-07; forbidden tool trace absent. Final independent review/security evidence current.
